title: Power Digital Alternatives for Meta Creative and Smaller Budgets
summary: Power Digital alternatives for Meta creative: Knowlify first, then agencies with published budget floors, minimums and scope, checked October 2026.
body_markdown:
## Which Meta-first agencies belong on the shortlist?


[Common Thread Collective's creative page](https://commonthreadco.com/pages/creative-production) sells UGC packages of 20, 40 or 80 ads from 5, 10 or 20 creators, with three to four weeks per batch, as of October 2026. Its Meta page frames media work around contribution margin and invites brands spending $100K or more a month on Meta to talk. The creative page does not say whether creative can be bought without CTC, so ask.


[Pilothouse's Meta ads page](https://www.pilothouse.co/services/meta-ads) lists static, motion and UGC concepts with hook, story and offer testing, next to media buying, and says it has served 500-plus DTC brands. Its[testing-framework post](https://www.pilothouse.co/post/meta-creative-testing-framework-the-3-3-3-approach-to-finding-winners) describes a 3-3-3 testing framework: three funnel levels, three angles and three formats, tested in equal-budget ad sets. Its[homepage](https://www.pilothouse.co/) says the agency is built for established DTC ecommerce brands, prices through monthly retainers, performance incentives and custom scopes, and typically begins onboarding within 5 to 10 business days of signing.


[Darkroom's paid media page](https://darkroomagency.com/services/paid-media) describes ideal clients as mid-market and enterprise consumer brands, typically with $10M to $500M in revenue. It says the fit is poor for single-channel brands and companies under roughly $5M. Pricing starts at $1,500 a month as a retainer plus a percentage of media, depending on channels.


[Biddyco](https://www.biddyco.com/) describes itself as a creative agency for brands spending $100k to $5M a month on Meta. It handles concepting, scripting, creator sourcing, editing and animation. Its Meta page says finished files arrive every two to four weeks, depending on the plan, and it does not describe running campaigns. Pair it with your own media buyer.


## Which alternative fits a smaller budget?


Power Digital's site gives no minimum, so a smaller budget cannot be confirmed from its page. Ask for a written quote before you rule it in or out. Two providers in the table publish a low entry point you can screen against today.


[CreatStrat](https://creatstrat.com/) lists $299 a month for 5 ads a week (20 to 25 a month), $499 for 10 and $899 for 20, billed monthly with cancel anytime. The page does not describe a revision policy or say whether a person reviews each ad, so ask both questions before you subscribe.


[LYFE Marketing's Facebook advertising page](https://www.lyfemarketing.com/facebook-advertising-services/) lists $500 a month for image ads, $800 for video ads and $1,400 for both, plus a $300 account setup fee it says you can call to waive. Clients start on a 3-month contract and then move to monthly. The page recommends no less than $500 a month in Facebook ad spend on top of the fee, and its plan table lists $1,000 or more of monthly ad spend for the video plans. The page says your ad spend goes directly to Facebook, so budget the plan fee and the spend separately.


## What should a Meta creative agency show before you sign?


Meta's[Andromeda engineering post](https://engineering.fb.com/2024/12/02/production-engineering/meta-andromeda-advantage-automation-next-gen-personalized-ads-retrieval-engine/) says the number of ad creatives in its recommendation systems is expected to grow significantly. That makes concept count more useful than file count. Ask each finalist how many distinct concepts it delivers a month, and how many are new angles rather than cut-downs or caption swaps.


Check two more things. First, ask who sets up and maintains tracking. Meta describes the[Conversions API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/conversions-api) as a connection from your server, website platform, app or CRM to its systems, so ask who fixes events when they stop arriving. Second, preview automated enhancements before launch. Meta's[Advantage+ creative page](https://www.facebook.com/business/ads/meta-advantage-plus/creative) says some enhancements may be on by default and can be turned off at any time.


For the testing step, see our[ad creative testing guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/ad-creative-testing) . For a wider shortlist of Meta agencies, read[best Meta ads agencies](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-meta-ads-agencies-2026) .


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick for finished Meta video ads, with creative-only or campaign-management scope on a custom quote.
- Power Digital's site does not list Meta or UGC as named services and publishes no pricing, so request a written scope before you compare.
- For a smaller budget, screen CreatStrat ($299 a month) and LYFE Marketing ($500 a month for image ads, $800 for video, plus setup) before a sales call.
- Ask every finalist how many distinct concepts it delivers each month, who owns Conversions API setup, and which Advantage+ enhancements are switched on.


## FAQ


### What is the best Power Digital alternative for Meta creative?


Knowlify is our top pick when you need finished Meta video ads with a person checking every ad. It can deliver creative only or add end-to-end Meta campaign management, on a custom quote. If you want Meta buying tied to a profit forecast, shortlist Common Thread Collective, and for static, motion and UGC concepts for DTC brands, shortlist Pilothouse.


### Does Power Digital publish pricing?


No. Its homepage, checked in October 2026, shows no pricing, retainer or minimum spend, and it offers a free marketing audit as the way to start. Request a written scope and fee before you compare it with providers that publish terms.


### Can a smaller brand afford a Meta creative agency?


Some can, but check the floor first. CreatStrat lists plans from $299 a month, LYFE Marketing from $500 a month plus setup (video plans start at $800), and Darkroom from $1,500 a month plus a percentage of media. Confirm what each price includes before you commit.


### Should I replace Power Digital or add a creative partner?


If Power Digital's strategy and paid media work is doing its job, adding a creative partner is usually the smaller change. If nobody owns concepts, hooks and approvals, a single creative provider with a defined monthly batch may be simpler. Run one batch from the new option before you change the rest of the account.
